  - At launch, it was the most powerful telecommunication satellite in orbit.
  - Carried 23 experiments and introduced several technological breakthroughs.
  - First 3-axis stabilized spacecraft in geostationary orbit.
  - First experimental use of electric propulsion in geostationary orbit.
  - Included the first heavy ion detector in geostationary orbit.

  - Launched in September 2007.
  - Replaced the previously lost INSAT-4C satellite.
  - Positioned in geostationary orbit at 74 degrees east.
